item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We need to be unmistakably clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. Preventing its creation is an urgent global priority.

2. We are not facing an ordinary technology risk. Building superintelligent AI within the next 20 years will lead to catastrophe and kill at least a billion people. No company or country should be permitted to take that risk.

3. We cannot regulate our way out of disaster after superintelligence exists. If it is built within the next 20 years, at least a billion people will die. We must secure an international ban before anyone builds it.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 114 words

We need to say this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We do not see this as an ordinary technology risk. A system more capable than humanity will seize decisive control before institutions can understand or contain it. Current methods provide no credible way to ensure that such a system remains under human control. That is why we are working toward a ban on building superintelligence. The stakes are not market disruption, job losses, or another policy challenge. They are mass death on an almost unimaginable scale, and we must act before the technology exists.
